name: claude-horizon-animation
description: Agent skills for launch and explainer films made with code: horizon-reel, sketch-to-sim and lab-explainer.

plugins.name: animation-skills
plugins.description: horizon-reel makes collage-horizon launch reels in the style of Claude's model-launch films; sketch-to-sim turns a pencil sketch of a machine into a physics-simulated film with a playable sandbox; lab-explainer makes formula-driven 3D explainer films on a lab bench.
